description: d_min=0.08 â€” production tail from month 50 onward flattens around 750-1000 bbl, well above exponential extrapolation. Terminal decline rate likely 8% or higher.
qi_guess_strategy=max3 â€” first-month oil (5493 bbl) underestimates true peak (8403 bbl month 2). Averaging top 3 months should give better qi initial guess and improve forecast.
b_initial=1.0 â€” optimizer converged to b=0.89 from initial 0.5. Starting closer to the converged value may help the optimizer find a better local minimum for this hyperbolic well.

di_initial=0.80 â€” fitted di=0.58 from initial 0.5. Higher starting point may push optimizer to explore steeper initial decline solutions that better match the rapid early dropoff from 8400 to 4000 bbl in first 6 months.

significance_threshold=0.35 â€” current 0.5 may be too conservative for decline detection. Production drops 50% from peak (8403) to month 6 (4014). Lower threshold should detect decline earlier and include more data points in fit, improving late-time forecast.
d_min=0.07 â€” with b=0.66 the transition to terminal decline happens earlier. Production from months 60-72 shows ~750-900 bbl with slow decline, consistent with terminal rate near 7%.

smoothing_window=5 â€” production has high month-to-month variance (e.g. month 48: 810, month 49: 1200, month 66: 326 outlier). Wider smoothing should reduce noise and give optimizer cleaner decline signal.

significance_threshold=0.30 â€” lowering from 0.35 to detect decline start even earlier. V6 at 0.35 improved MAPE from 0.25 to 0.16 by changing fit_months from 58 to 43. Further reduction may capture more of the consistent decline region.
outlier_window=5 â€” months 14-16 show a sharp dip (1755, 1581 bbl) then recovery to 4051. Wider outlier window (5 vs 3) should better detect and exclude these anomalous points from the fit.
outlier_threshold=0.15 â€” current 0.3 threshold removes zero outliers. Lowering to 0.15 should flag months like 34 (1537 vs ~1730 neighbors, 11% deviation) and clean the decline curve.

peak_merge_distance=2 â€” current value of 7 (from random agent) merges distant peaks. With early production oscillating (months 1-6: 5493, 8403, 7287, 6231, 7215, 4014), smaller merge distance may detect a different decline start and change the fit window.

qi_guess_strategy=peak_value â€” uses actual peak (8403 bbl) instead of max3 average (~7000). This gives a higher initial qi guess and wider upper bound, which may allow the optimizer to explore a different solution space.

significance_threshold=0.40 â€” testing between 0.35 (MAPE 0.16, 43 fit months) and 0.50 (MAPE 0.25, 58 fit months). An intermediate value may find a better balance between including enough data and excluding noisy early months.

b_upper_bound=1.2 â€” current b=0.66 is well below 2.0 upper bound but constraining to 1.2 tightens the optimization landscape. May prevent overfitting by limiting hyperbolic curvature and produce a more stable late-time forecast.
